name: branch-housekeeping
description: Two halves, deliberately separate. The `branch-housekeeping` SKILL reports the state of the remote branches across every configured Umbraco MCP repo in one run and posts a Slack digest — classifying each non-protected branch by its GitHub PR state (authoritative where git ancestry isn't, since these repos squash-merge) into safe-to-remove, merged-but-reused-since, closed unmerged, no PR, and open. It is read-only and never deletes, so it's safe to run or schedule at any time. The `/clean-branches` COMMAND is the separate, deliberate cleanup: a purely mechanical script with no model in the loop that re-verifies every branch against the API before deleting it. Run it only when you want branches gone. Local-only — the GitHub MCP server has no branch-delete tool.
